messages:
Mira Patel: Hey team — Crestline just sent over a SIG. They specifically flagged Q12 (KMS/key mgmt), Q18 (network segmentation), and Q42 (incident response). I'm starting a thread to collect attachments and small snippets. Can folks pick up items? We need to hand this back by EOW (Friday).

Dan Kim: I can own Q12. I already have our KMS rotation attestation + HSM certs. Will upload to shared drive in a sec.

Olga Ramos: I'll take Q18. Need the latest VPC diagram and the firewall policy excerpt. Who has the diagram that includes transit gateway peering?

Alex B.: @Olga pushed v2 of the VPC diagram to `\share\security\network-diagrams\Crestline_v2.pdf` just now. Also adding a short config excerpt here:
```
vpc-setup:
  public_subnets: 2
  private_subnets: 4
  transit_gateway: disabled
  peering: none
```

Jordan (solutions): For Q42 I'll attach the IR runbook and our SRR template. I'll redact customer names and put them in a temp folder. Any required format (PDF vs docx)?

Mira Patel: PDF is better for them. Also Dan — can you include a KMS policy snippet they can reference? They asked for policy statements that show rotation and access controls.

Dan Kim: Uploading `kms-rotation-proof.pdf` and `kms-policy-snippet.json` now. Links:
https://drive.redwood.internal/sig/crestline/kms-rotation-proof.pdf
https://drive.redwood.internal/sig/crestline/kms-policy-snippet.json

sec-bot: Evidence upload recorded: 3 files added by Dan Kim (kms-rotation-proof.pdf, kms-policy-snippet.json, crestline_vpc_excerpt.txt).

Alex B.: :thumbsup:

Olga Ramos: Quick Q — Crestline also asked for sample flow logs. Should we provide raw logs or synthetic samples?

Alex B.: We should only provide synthetic samples. Use the redaction pipeline. Example:
`python tools/redact_logs.py --input sample_flow.log --output sample_flow_redacted.log --sample 10`

Jordan (solutions): Uploaded `IR_runbook_redacted.pdf` to the same drive folder. Also included an executive summary paragraph for Q42.

Mira Patel: Great progress. Checklist for delivery:
- Q12: Dan -> KMS docs + policy snippet (done)
- Q18: Olga -> VPC diagram + firewall excerpt (Alex uploaded)
- Q42: Jordan -> IR runbook & summary (done)
I'll assemble a single ZIP and send to Crestline by Friday 3pm PST. Anyone need more time?

Dan Kim: fine for me.

Olga Ramos: fine.

Alex B.: good.

Mira Patel: Thanks all — I'll post the final ZIP link here when ready. /cc @security-review for FYI.
